user_amendment: 2026-10-14: user authorized AI instead of independent human annotation, and investigator-defined ABCR loss. AI is never labeled human.

A.sample: Reuse all 72 preregistered R2 pairs, stages7/8/9 x SHARE/BIF x physical gate. No resampling by outcomes.
A.blinding: New hashed IDs; hide SHARE/BIF, score, physical gate, previous AI labels, and all optimization outcomes.
A.simulator: Load original per-demo XML and states[t+1], forward only; no rollout or training. Record target/gripper contacts and object/EEF motion. Missing/unalignable state means UNKNOWN.
A.criterion: Comparable target-relative geometry, manipulation phase, motion and contact configuration. Object identity alone is not rejection; identical action is not a criterion.

precision_gate.scope: Each SHARE/BIF class within physical-PASS stratum. Stratified diversity sample, not unbiased population precision.

B.anchors: First and last directly saved complete anchor per seed/task, 12 total; no replay; Task9 unavailable.
B.pairs: All old R2 pairs in task7/8 uniquely present in each seed native plan; preserve both physical strata. Primary subset physical PASS; AI-certified subset secondary; no replacement.
B.update: New-window official terminal GMM BC only, native full decoder+head AdamW moments, LR, clipping; CPU deterministic eval. Per-pair complete restore.
B.outcome: old-window actual NLL difference after the candidate FP32 update, never action-label agreement
B.cv: Leave one checkpoint out AND exclude any training row sharing either task-qualified trajectory with each test row. Per-row training-fold standardization; fixed ridge=1, intercept unpenalized; no tuning.
B.bootstrap: 2000 fixed-seed samples at checkpoint level, plus separate trajectory-pair clustering sensitivity; repeated windows never independent samples.

C.batch: Exact saved native record_indices; preserve variable old/new slots; no retrieval or added samples.
C.base_loss: Original mean terminal GMM NLL on exact mixed batch (saved MLR anchors have IFA disabled). No new IFA added.
C.z: L2-normalized native temporal decoder terminal representation, before GMM head, 512 dimensions.
C.pair_gate: Same pre-FiLM beta0.5 visual/state frozen stage thresholds, q4 command thresholds and physical gate as R1-R4. Exact source identity, complete future, no label from loss.
C.share_loss: mean(1 - dot(z_new, stop_gradient(z_old))) over eligible SHARE pairs; zero when none
C.bif_loss: mean(relu(dot(z_new, stop_gradient(z_old)) - 0.5)) over eligible BIF pairs; zero when none
C.status: Investigator-defined exploratory ABCR-v1 under explicit user authorization; not a published or previously validated ABCR implementation.
C.randomness: Restore same saved CPU RNG and native training modes before each branch. Evaluation deterministic eval. No extra forward to build auxiliary loss; reuse compute_loss last_feat.
C.probes: Up to12 old +12 new per start, balanced task/trajectory, exact identities. Trajectories disjoint from all batch trajectories within each task. No same-trajectory substitution.
C.no_activation: Return exact MLR parity, report no intervention evidence; never fabricate active pairs.
C.full_training: Not authorized by this diagnostic. Failure of B incremental gate means no recommendation for full BIF training.
